description: Figure 5 illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT. The horizontal axis displays categories labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball”, in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. Three sets of bars are presented for each category, representing data for “LLama3” (blue), “Qwen2” (orange), and “ChatGPT” (green). Each bar’s height indicates the proportion; for example, in the “Movies” category, the “LLama3” bar reaches approximately 72%, the “Qwen2” bar reaches approximately 78%, and the “ChatGPT” bar reaches approximately 62%.  In the “Songs” category, the “LLama3” bar reaches approximately 68%, the “Qwen2” bar reaches approximately 74%, and the “ChatGPT” bar reaches approximately 58%. Finally, in the “Basketball” category, the “LLama3” bar reaches approximately 64%, the “Qwen2” bar reaches approximately 70%, and the “ChatGPT” bar reaches approximately 54%. The bars are grouped by category, with each group containing one bar for each of the three models. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
